description: Voigtländer于1936年推出的折叠相机。配备3.5/Skopar f1:3.5/Heliar f1:3.6.。

specs.英文简介: The Bessa Rangefinder or Bessa RF (also known as the Bessa E Messer, from Entfernungsmesser, the German for 'rangefinder') was introduced in 1936, one of a long-running series of Bessa cameras made by Voigtländer.
